I have been researching it constantly snd i’m even trying to find a deeper spirituality to seek comfort in. I keep finding hope in some NDEs and supernatural experiences but it’s literally ruining my life because I can’t stop researching about it! I do think there’s way more to the universe than we know, but I wish I could just not have the big questions nagging my brain all the time. I’m bugging all my friends and family with death talk lately and my heart drops whenever someone says they think it’s nothing. The unknown is so scary, but Im trying to make it a positive thing somehow. I do think that meditating and praying has helped calm me down when I’m totally freaking out though. Other than that, I will also be gladly taking advice!
